import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'src')
from werkzeug.sansio.multipart import MultipartDecoder, Data, File, Field, Epilogue, NeedData

boundary = b'063afc4cbe46a74059098814397 1e2bd'.replace(b' ', b'')
header = b'--' + boundary + b'\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"file\"; filename=\"f\"\r\nContent-Type: application/octet-stream\r\n\r\n'
payload = b'\x00' * 65431
trailer = b'\r\n--' + boundary + b'--\r\n'
full = header + payload + trailer

def run(split_at):
    d = MultipartDecoder(boundary=boundary)
    chunk1 = full[:split_at]
    chunk2 = full[split_at:]
    data_bytes = b''
    for chunk in [chunk1, chunk2, None]:
        d.receive_data(chunk)
        ev = d.next_event()
        while not isinstance(ev, (Epilogue, NeedData)):
            if isinstance(ev, Data):
                data_bytes += ev.data
            ev = d.next_event()
        if isinstance(ev, Epilogue):
            break
    return data_bytes

base = len(header)+len(payload)
for off in range(-3,6):
    sp = base+off
    db = run(sp)
    ok = db == payload
    print(off, sp, ok, len(db), repr(db[-3:]) if not ok else '')
"
